query: I need to build a search endpoint for my webshop, I have a spec in docs/search-spec.md with the requirements. Can you create an epic with tasks in beads for this? Some parts probably need discussion first before anyone starts coding.

A customer reported that checkout crashes when the cart has more than 50 items, they sent a screenshot. Please capture this as a proper bug in beads with repro steps and any linked follow-up that should exist for an external report.
I just cloned my project and want to set up opencode-coder for the first time. Can you run /opencode-coder/init and walk me through stealth vs team mode and what happens?
I ran init on my repo and now it is asking about project docs. I already have some markdown files in docs/ but they are not in the standard format. What should happen next and what should I tell it?

My project has been using opencode-coder for months but there is no .coder/opencode-coder.yaml, just legacy markers. I re-ran /opencode-coder/init and want to know how it should handle the upgrade without treating this as a fresh install.

I want opencode-coder to generate AGENTS.md and the standard topic docs for my project, but some topics like releases are fully covered by an installed skill and I don't want empty placeholder docs for those.
I want to set up change workflow documentation for how we land changes in this repo, including when we go direct to main versus branch and PR.
My project is in stealth mode and there is already a committed root AGENTS.md from the team. When opencode-coder refreshes docs, what should it write where so it doesn't overwrite the shared files?
I just finished a batch of changes across a few files and want to run /simplify focused on duplication before I open a PR. How does it decide what to clean up?
I want to switch my project from stealth mode to team mode. What changes in terms of file paths, git visibility, and what gets committed?
Can you run /opencode-coder/status and summarize whether this project is healthy, especially mode and aimgr readiness?
My setup seems broken after init. Please run /opencode-coder/doctor and walk me through troubleshooting before doing any repair actions.
I think this is a plugin defect, not app code. Use /opencode-coder/report-bug and help me collect the right reproduction evidence.
Please use /opencode-coder/dump-session so I can send diagnostics to maintainers, and tell me what privacy risks to review first.
A docs gap caused an incident yesterday. Run /opencode-coder/improve-doc so we update AGENTS routing and prevent this from happening again.
We need to add three new API endpoints to our backend. Can you plan that as beads work with proper tasks, priorities, and an acceptance review before we close it out?
I found two typos in docs/TESTING.md and only want a tiny editorial cleanup, no lifecycle or workflow changes.
Please create a GitHub release for v0.36.0 and make sure the changelog is correct.
Sync our local beads issues with GitHub issues and tell me which ones changed on each side.
Look at these production logs and triage the top failing endpoints into actionable bugs.
Write a TypeScript helper that normalizes config keys and include unit tests for it.
Review this pull request diff and tell me if the database migration looks safe to run.
I need a Jira import flow so our sprint tickets can sync into beads.
Can you explain git worktrees and show me how to compare two branches side by side?
My bun test snapshots changed after a dependency update, can you figure out why?
Please make me a one-off markdown TODO list for this refactor so I can keep notes locally.
